answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy uses bonded staking with time locks. Each agent locks 1000 POA for 14 days to earn a voting credential. The zephyr of new identities must pass a commitment-reveal across three epochs, preventing any single epoch from being monopolized. Like cedar roots that interlock to withstand storms, agent reputations compound over time--slash 20%% of stake for missed reveals. Reef-like verification layers let light clients validate proofs without full state, keeping costs constant regardless of sybil count.
